style: Day of the Tentacle / 1990s hand-drawn point-and-click adventure-game illustration, matching the attached website and approved bed STYLE REFERENCES. Playful crooked geometry, wonky perspective, bent structural lines, crisp thin dark ink outlines, flat cel-shaded color shapes, a few hard-edged highlights. 2D hand-drawn illustrated volume. Use the application palette: turquoise #00C3A0, cyan #2ABDFF, pink #FF37C7, violet #8251FB, fuchsia #F50DB4, small orange #FF4D00 accents, white and darker shades of those for shadows. Mix 2-4 colors on distinct parts.
